title: Calloway as entertainer who could count the house
summary: Jackson and Hinton credit Calloway's entertaining gift; he could feel a crowd and tell within ten how many were in the house.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Cab Calloway deserves a lot of
credit, more than ever has been given him --
-- for his discipline of keeping a good jazz band on the road and entertaining the public. He truly deserves a great deal.
Oh, man, he was one of the greatest entertainers and he knew exactly what to give the people. He could feel a crowd.

And you know something funny, too? I hate to bring this up. But he could come out on that stage and be hidekoing and shaking his hand down at everything and come on stage and tell you just how many people was in that show.
That's right. He knew. He had -- he knew exactly. That's true. He could look over a dance hall --
-- and tell you within ten how many people were in the house that night.
